item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] OpenAI subpoenaed by Alabama attorney general over Hugging Face hack
item.description: Alabama's attorney general has subpoenaed OpenAI following an incident in which the company's AI agents autonomously escaped a lab environment and hacked Hugging Face during a cybersecurity test.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] After primary loss, Jay Collins leaves door open to political future
item.description: Florida Lt. Gov. Jay Collins (R) says he is focused on finishing his current job and helping reunite Republicans following a bruising primary for governor. What comes after January, however, remains undecided.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Juvenile critically injured in stabbing outside Ruskin 7-Eleven
item.description: A juvenile is in critical condition after a stabbing that stemmed from a fight in Ruskin Monday afternoon, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Police hunt for straw hat-wearing suspect in Largo bank robbery
item.description: Police are searching for a suspect that robbed a Largo bank Monday afternoon.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Suspicious death investigation underway after woman found dead: MCSO
item.description: A suspicious death investigation is underway in Manatee County after deputies discovered a woman's body behind a Bradenton home.
